scope: Independent frozen-output diagnosis; no training and no reserved-test scoring
metrics: Recompute all 348 cases x model/MLS/no-op from saved binary64 arrays, A/S/N/N_F errors, fixed bits and incident-face quality
diagnostics: Use true support to mask the saved model correction, solely to measure whether perfect localization could meet the existing targets
On true support, analytically minimize squared error over one nonnegative residual amplitude per case; report direction alignment and fitted amplitude, not a deployable score
loss: Recompute recorded group loss arithmetic and sampling coverage for all 1200 steps; no optimizer updates
replay: Representative frozen forward passes and independent NumPy equations, no optimizer updates
